title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio for Multiple Uses on a Zoning Lot
previewText: When more than one use is located on a zoning lot, the maximum floor area ratio permitted for any use on such zoning lot shall not exceed the maximum permitted for such use, as set forth in Sections 104-21 through 104-24, inclusive, provided that the total of all such floor area ratios does not exceed the greatest floor area ratio permitted for any such use on the zoning lot.
